# Bar Raiser: Architecture, Influence, and Values

[← Uber](../README.md) · [Every Uber question](../../uber.md) · [Read it on TrueInterview](https://trueinterview.io/study/bar-raiser-architecture-and-values)

`culture-fit` `leadership`

---

## Requirements

- Walk through a complex system architecture you worked on previously, covering the key technical decisions and trade-offs that were yours to make.
- Tell how you managed a technical dispute within your team and how you pushed for the adoption of technical standards.
- Provide a specific instance that shows customer focus or ownership, aligned with Uber’s values.
- Anticipate follow-up questions that distinguish your personal decisions and impact from the team’s overall work.

## Preparation

- Have one architecture story ready that includes clear constraints, alternatives you dismissed, the criteria for your decision, and a measurable result.
- Prepare one influence story demonstrating how you settled a disagreement without leaning solely on authority.
- Map two brief STAR-format stories to customer focus and ownership, containing sufficient technical depth for a senior interviewer to dig into.
